IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Recipes', N'U') IS NOT NULL
   AND OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.UnitOfMeasure', N'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    EXEC(N'UPDATE r
    SET BatchUomId = CASE
        WHEN m.BaseUomID IN (3, 10) THEN 10
        ELSE 9
    END
    FROM dbo.Recipes r
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Materials m ON r.MaterialID = m.MaterialID
    WHERE r.BatchUomId IS NULL');

    EXEC(N'UPDATE dbo.Recipes
    SET BatchUomId = 10
    WHERE (RecipeName LIKE N''%ống%'' OR Note LIKE N''%ml/%'')');
END;

    ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)

    ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)

LEFT JOIN [ProductionOrders] AS [p1] ON [p].[OrderID] = [p1].[OrderID]
LEFT JOIN [Recipes] AS [r] ON [p1].[RecipeID] = [r].[RecipeID]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [p2].[OrderBomId], [p2].[MaterialId], [p2].[RequiredQuantity], [p2].[DispensingStatus], CASE
        WHEN [m].[MaterialID] IS NOT NULL THEN [m].[MaterialName]
        ELSE N'Unknown'
    END AS [MaterialName], CASE
        WHEN [m].[MaterialID] IS NOT NULL THEN [m].[MaterialCode]
        ELSE ''
    END AS [MaterialCode], CASE
        WHEN [u].[UomID] IS NOT NULL THEN [u].[UomName]
        ELSE N'N/A'
    END AS [UomName], [m].[MaterialID] AS [MaterialID0], [u].[UomID], [p2].[BatchId]
    FROM [ProductionOrderBom] AS [p2]
    LEFT JOIN [Materials] AS [m] ON [p2].[MaterialId] = [m].[MaterialID]
    LEFT JOIN [UnitOfMeasure] AS [u] ON [p2].[UomId] = [u].[UomID]
) AS [t] ON [p].[BatchID] = [t].[BatchId]
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM [ProductionOrderBom] AS [p0]
    WHERE [p].[BatchID] = [p0].[BatchId])
ORDER BY [p].[BatchID], [p1].[OrderID], [r].[RecipeID], [t].[OrderBomId], [t].[MaterialID0]

    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [ProductionOrderBom] AS [p3]
        WHERE [p].[BatchID] = [p3].[BatchId]) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [ProductionOrderBom] AS [p4]
        WHERE [p].[BatchID] = [p4].[BatchId] AND [p4].[DispensingStatus] <> N'Dispensed') THEN CAST(1 AS bit)
    ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)
END
FROM [ProductionBatches] AS [p]
LEFT JOIN [ProductionOrders] AS [p1] ON [p].[OrderID] = [p1].[OrderID]
LEFT JOIN [Recipes] AS [r] ON [p1].[RecipeID] = [r].[RecipeID]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [p2].[OrderBomId], [p2].[MaterialId], [p2].[RequiredQuantity], [p2].[DispensingStatus], CASE
        WHEN [m].[MaterialID] IS NOT NULL THEN [m].[MaterialName]
        ELSE N'Unknown'
    END AS [MaterialName], CASE
        WHEN [m].[MaterialID] IS NOT NULL THEN [m].[MaterialCode]
        ELSE ''
    END AS [MaterialCode], CASE
        WHEN [u].[UomID] IS NOT NULL THEN [u].[UomName]
        ELSE N'N/A'
    END AS [UomName], CASE
        WHEN [i].[LotId] IS NOT NULL THEN [i].[LotNumber]
        ELSE 'Chưa chỉ định'
    END AS [SelectedLotNumber], [m].[MaterialID] AS [MaterialID0], [u].[UomID], [i].[LotId], [p2].[BatchId]
    FROM [ProductionOrderBom] AS [p2]
    LEFT JOIN [Materials] AS [m] ON [p2].[MaterialId] = [m].[MaterialID]
    LEFT JOIN [UnitOfMeasure] AS [u] ON [p2].[UomId] = [u].[UomID]
    LEFT JOIN [InventoryLots] AS [i] ON [p2].[SelectedLotId] = [i].[LotId]
) AS [t] ON [p].[BatchID] = [t].[BatchId]
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM [ProductionOrderBom] AS [p0]
    WHERE [p].[BatchID] = [p0].[BatchId]) AND ([p].[Status] <> N'Completed' OR [p].[Status] IS NULL) AND ([p].[Status] <> N'Cancelled' OR [p].[Status] IS NULL)
ORDER BY [p].[BatchID], [p1].[OrderID], [r].[RecipeID], [t].[OrderBomId], [t].[MaterialID0], [t].[UomID]
